Brilliant dentist. I had complex broken root canal teeth and a dangerously low sinus wall and he was able to extract both teeth surgically without touching my sinuses. Stitched me up afterwards and I'm already feeling way better and it's only the next morning. You can tell that the dentist has a lot of experience and his English was also very good. They were also able to see me with just 30 minutes notice following collection of my x-ray from a nearby facility. If the dentist had not been highly skilled they could have perforated my sinus wall so I am very grateful that this dentist was so experienced and good at his job. I will be using this dentist for all of my checkups and potential treatment in the future. Fees were also competitive and affordable. Also the anaesthetic needle I barely noticed him use even with it being the roof of my mouth. One of the best dentists I have found in Phuket in nearly 5 years.
